---
title: "Page not found"
title-tr: "Sayfa bulunamadı"
---

<!-- Quarto writes this page's links against the site path (/crop-markets/), because
     GitHub Pages serves it at whatever URL was missing. Keep links as .qmd/.html paths.
     GitHub Pages serves only the root 404.html (render_site.py drops the Turkish one),
     so this page carries both languages: the script below shows the one whose tree the
     missing URL is in; without JavaScript both show. Each block's button leads to its
     tree's home, which is also how the script finds the trees. -->

::: {.notfound}
::: {lang="en" data-title="Page not found – Crop Markets"}
<span class="eyebrow">Error 404</span>

# This page is not here.

[The link may be old, or the page may have moved when the site was reorganised. Everything
still lives under the same few pages.]{.lede}

::: {.btns}
[Back to the start <svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#arrow-right"/></svg>](index.qmd){.btn .pri}
:::
:::

::: {lang="tr" data-title="Sayfa bulunamadı – Ürün Piyasaları"}
<span class="eyebrow">Hata 404</span>

# Bu sayfa burada yok.

[Bağlantı eski olabilir ya da sayfa, site yeniden düzenlenirken taşınmış olabilir. Her şey
hâlâ aynı birkaç sayfada duruyor.]{.lede}

::: {.btns}
[Ana sayfaya dönün <svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#arrow-right"/></svg>](tr/index.html){.btn .pri}
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script>
/* Show the language of the tree the missing URL is in, set <html lang> and the tab title
   to match, and give site.js's language switch this URL in the other tree. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var blocks = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".notfound > [lang]"));
  var trees = blocks.map(function (b) {
    var home = b.querySelector(".btns a[href]");
    return { block: b, lang: b.getAttribute("lang"), root: home ? new URL(".", home.href).pathname : null };
  }).filter(function (t) { return t.root; });
  var path = location.pathname, here = null;
  trees.forEach(function (t) {  // the deepest root the URL is under ("/x/tr/" over "/x/")
    if (path.indexOf(t.root) === 0 && (!here || t.root.length > here.root.length)) here = t;
  });
  if (!here) return;
  var rest = path.slice(here.root.length);
  var html = document.documentElement;
  html.setAttribute("lang", here.lang);
  html.setAttribute("xml:lang", here.lang);
  trees.forEach(function (t) {
    if (t !== here) {
      t.block.hidden = true;
      var link = document.createElement("link");
      link.rel = "alternate";
      link.setAttribute("hreflang", t.lang);
      link.setAttribute("data-href", t.root + rest);
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    }
  });
  if (here.block.getAttribute("data-title")) document.title = here.block.getAttribute("data-title");
})();
</script>
```
